items.name: ouro-base
items.title: Ouro base
items.description: Add it once per app, before your first component; no component installs it, so later adds never touch your stylesheet. What every Ouro UI component needs in the app's CSS: success and warning colors, a destructive foreground, the field border color (--input) and --radius when your theme has none, the motion tokens, the press utility, the keyframes for spinners, progress bars and skeletons, and --ouro-layer, the z-index of sheets and dialogs (50; raise it in a :root rule of your own if your app has fixed bars above z-50).

items.name: ouro-plain
items.title: Ouro plain markup
items.description: Ouro UI's states as classes, for markup that is not an Ouro component, such as rows and controls a page builds as strings or prerenders to read without a script: the focus ring, a linked row, a disclosure, a skip link, actions shown on hover or focus, current links, toggles, segmented choices and options. Add it once, after ouro-base, only if your app has such markup.

items.name: ouro-theme
items.title: Ouro theme
items.description: Ouro UI's own look, as a shadcn theme for :root and .dark. Skip it to keep your app's theme.

items.name: ouro-lib
items.title: Ouro lib
items.description: Every helper in lib/ouro in one item. You don't need to add it: each component installs only the helpers it imports (the lib-<name> items).

items.name: ouro-testing
items.title: Ouro testing
items.description: Installed with every -tests item; you don't need to add it. The test kit Ouro UI's tests use: Vitest browser projects with the drag, flick, tap, doubleTap, touchDrag, touchStep, pointerPress, emulateMedia, pageZoom, resetPageZoom, setPageZoom and restoreTouch commands, the rotate helper (which turns the phone viewport and resets Chromium's zoom; the ouro-touch project fails a test that leaves the page zoomed), the act helper, the holdFrames helper (which holds animation frames and the clock still so a test steps a spring itself), the motion helpers (expectMotion, expectNoMotion, expectGestureSettle, expectTransition and parseDuration, which prove exactly which CSS properties a state change runs on each part), watchAnnouncements (which records what live regions announce, so a test proves a message is heard once per change), axeExclude, and the end-to-end story helper.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A button, or a link styled as one.

items.name: text
items.title: Text
items.description: Body text in the theme's type scale and colors.

items.name: heading
items.title: Heading
items.description: A section title, `<h1>` to `<h6>`, in the theme's foreground color.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A panel that slides in from an edge and is dragged back to dismiss: the mobile form of a dialog.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A dialog that presents itself for the screen: a centered dialog on wider screens and a bottom sheet you can drag away on phones (below 640px).

items.name: confirm-dialog
items.title: ConfirmDialog
items.description: Asks the user to confirm an action, with Cancel focused first.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: A labeled form control: the label, an optional description, the control and its error, wired together with ids that match between the server and the browser.

items.name: fieldset
items.title: Fieldset
items.description: A titled group of related fields, such as an address, rendered as a `<fieldset>` named by its legend.

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: A text link that navigates through your router.

items.name: text-field
items.title: TextField
items.description: A labeled one-line text input on the Field contract: pass `label`, and `error` from your server action or client check.

items.name: text-area
items.title: TextArea
items.description: A labeled multi-line text field on the Field contract, a native `<textarea>`: pass `label`, and `error` from your server action or client check.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A labeled checkbox on the Field contract, with the label to its right: pass `label`, and `checked` with `onCheckedChange` (or `defaultChecked`).

items.name: checkbox-group
items.title: CheckboxGroup
items.description: A group of checkboxes under one legend, on the Field contract, for picking any number of choices: pass `legend`, and `options` (or `Checkbox` children).

items.name: radio-group
items.title: RadioGroup
items.description: A group of radios under one legend, on the Field contract, for picking exactly one choice: pass `legend`, and `options` (or `Radio` children).

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A labeled on/off switch on the Field contract, with the label to its right: pass `label`, and `checked` with `onCheckedChange` (or `defaultChecked`).

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: A form that validates with the browser's own constraints (`required`, `type="email"`, `pattern`) and shows server errors on the matching fields.

items.name: edit-sheet
items.title: EditSheet
items.description: Edits something in a form inside a dialog: the whole interaction, done right.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A labeled list of choices on the Field contract: pass `label`, `options` (or `SelectItem` children) and `error` from your server action or client check.

items.name: native-select
items.title: NativeSelect
items.description: A labeled native `<select>` on the Field contract: pass `label`, `options` (or `<option>` children) and `error`.

items.name: number-field
items.title: NumberField
items.description: A labeled number input on the Field contract: pass `label`, and `error` from your server action or client check.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A labeled slider on the Field contract: pass `label`, and a `defaultValue` (or `value` with `onValueChange`).

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A text input that filters a list of items as people type, on the Field contract: pass `label`, `items`, and `error` from your server action or client check.

items.name: toaster
items.title: Toaster
items.description: Shows the toasts you send with `toast("Saved")` from `@/lib/ouro/toast`: render it once, at the root of your app, inside `OuroProvider` if you use one, or alone.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A small spinning ring that says an action is under way, inline: in a field's adornment, a toast's or a menu entry's icon, or beside the words that say what is happening.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A bar that shows how far along a task is, or that it is under way when you can't tell.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A placeholder that breathes after a second in the shape and size of content that is still loading, so the content takes its place without moving anything.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A person's picture, or their initials until it loads or when it fails, in a color picked from the name.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A short label for a status, category or count: "Draft", "Vegan", "3".

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: An inline message in the page: something saved, something failed, something to know before going on.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A thin line in the theme's border color between groups of content, horizontal or vertical.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A keyboard shortcut, in the reader's platform's notation: `keys={["mod", "k"]}` shows ⌘K on a Mac, iPhone or iPad and Ctrl+K elsewhere.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A small panel beside its trigger, for a short form or a few choices: a share link, filters, a quick edit.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short label that appears beside its trigger on hover and keyboard focus, for an icon button's purpose or a control's shortcut.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: HoverCard
items.description: A preview of where a link goes, shown when a mouse rests on the link or the keyboard focuses it: a cook's profile, a recipe's summary.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: A list of actions that opens from a button, from a right-click or long press, or from a menubar, with one API for all three.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A command palette: a searchable list of every action in the app, in a dialog.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabs that switch between panels in place: an accessible tab list with roving focus, arrow-key navigation, a line that slides to the selected tab, and 44px tabs on touch screens.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: SegmentedControl
items.description: An iOS-style segmented control: a row of equal segments with a raised thumb that slides to the checked one, for switching how one view shows its content in place, such as list or grid.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: A stack of titles that each open their own content, for FAQs and long settings pages.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: One section that opens and closes under its title, such as nutrition facts under a recipe.

items.name: show-more
items.title: ShowMore
items.description: "Show more" for a long list or a long text.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A surface that groups one thing's content: a media slot across the top, a title with a description and an action, a body, and a footer.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: One row of a list: leading media, a title with a description, and trailing actions.

items.name: item-group
items.title: ItemGroup
items.description: A list of `Item` rows, with an optional label that names it, lines between the rows, and what to show when it is empty.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: What a list, search or page shows when it has nothing in it: an icon, a title that says what is empty, a sentence on what to do, and the action that does it.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: ScrollArea
items.description: A scrolling region with a thin scrollbar in the theme's color, inside a height you set.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: AspectRatio
items.description: A frame that keeps an image, video or map at a fixed shape while its width follows the layout, so the page does not jump when the media loads.

items.name: stack
items.title: Stack
items.description: Lays its children out top to bottom with an even gap.

items.name: row
items.title: Row
items.description: Lays its children out side by side with an even gap, centered up and down.

items.name: navbar
items.title: Navbar
items.description: The bar across the top of an app: your brand, the main links and a few controls, with the current page marked `aria-current="page"`, and the link of the section it is in `aria-current="true"`, both underlined in the primary colour, distinct from hover and press highlights.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: The column of links down the side of an app, in sections, with the current page marked `aria-current="page"` and a bar at the start edge, distinct from hover and press highlights.

items.name: sidebar-layout
items.title: SidebarLayout
items.description: The shell of an app with a `Sidebar`: the sidebar beside the page from 640px up, in view while the page scrolls, and a sticky top bar with the sidebar's menu button below 640px.

items.name: stacked-layout
items.title: StackedLayout
items.description: The shell of an app with a `Navbar`: the bar across the top, in view while the page scrolls, an optional `toolbar` under it for the page's own tools, and the page below them in a centered column.

items.name: auth-layout
items.title: AuthLayout
items.description: The page for signing in, signing up or resetting a password: one `Card` in the middle of the screen, with your brand, the title as the page's `<h1>`, the form, and a line under the card.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: The trail from the top of the site to the current page: a labelled `<nav>` with an ordered list of links, the last item marked `aria-current="page"`.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page navigation for a long list: Previous, the page numbers with gaps, and Next, with the current page marked `aria-current="page"`.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: NavigationMenu
items.description: A row of links where some open a panel of further links, each with a line of description: the navigation of a site with more pages than fit in a bar.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: A data table: a caption, column headers, and rows, from `columns` and `rows` or from parts.

items.name: description-list
items.title: DescriptionList
items.description: One thing's details as pairs of a term and its value: a recipe's prep time and servings, an order's date and total, an account's email.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A button that stays pressed until it is pressed again, such as Bold in a text toolbar.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: ToggleGroup
items.description: A row of related toggles that share one value, such as text alignment or bold, italic and underline in a toolbar.

items.name: button-group
items.title: ButtonGroup
items.description: Related buttons joined into one control, such as Previous, a page number and Next, or a split button.

items.name: otp-field
items.title: OtpField
items.description: A one-time code entry on the Field contract: one slot per character, with focus that moves as the person types, a whole code pasted at once, and `autoComplete="one-time-code"` so phones offer the code from a text message.

items.name: file-field
items.title: FileField
items.description: A labeled file input with a drop zone, on the Field contract.

items.name: color-field
items.title: ColorField
items.description: A color on the Field contract: a swatch that opens the system color picker, next to the same color as hex text, kept in step both ways.

items.name: swipe-actions
items.title: SwipeActions
items.description: A list row with actions beside it that a horizontal swipe reveals: swipe toward the start for the `trailing` actions (Delete, Archive), toward the end for the `leading` ones (Pin).

items.name: reorderable
items.title: Reorderable
items.description: A list the user puts in order: recipe steps, a queue, favorites.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month grid to pick a day or a range of days, with the arrow keys or a press.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: DatePicker
items.description: A labeled date field.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: A row of slides the user swipes or steps through with Previous and Next buttons: recipe photos, a few featured cards.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Panels side by side (or stacked) with a draggable handle between each pair: a file list beside an editor, a preview above a console.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: A chart drawn in the theme's colors, which people can use without seeing it: a figure named by its `title`, a summary for screen readers, and a table of every value (visible with `showTable`).

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: One message in a chat: who wrote it, their avatar and what they wrote, with any attachments under it.

items.name: message-list
items.title: MessageList
items.description: A conversation: `Message`s in a scrolling, labeled region that opens at the newest one.

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment
items.description: A file attached to a chat message, or waiting to be sent with one: an icon for its kind, its name and size, or with `preview` the picture itself.

items.name: thread-summary
items.title: ThreadSummary
items.description: The line under a post that leads to its thread: who replied, "N replies" (a button that opens the thread) and when the last reply came.

items.name: checklist
items.title: Checklist
items.description: A list of things to tick off, such as a recipe's ingredients or a shopping list: each row a checkbox the whole row toggles, with an optional value and action.

items.name: inspector
items.title: Inspector
items.description: X-ray for a page built with Ouro HX: outlines every Ouro component on the page with its name, linked to its docs, and lists them all for keyboard and screen reader users.

items.name: skip-link
items.title: SkipLink
items.description: The "Skip to main content" link a keyboard or screen-reader user meets first on every page, so one Tab and Enter jump past the header and navigation.

items.name: tab-bar
items.title: TabBar
items.description: The bar of tabs at the bottom of a phone screen: two to five of the app's top-level pages, each an icon over a short label, with the current page marked `aria-current="page"` and an accent wash.

items.name: route-progress
items.title: RouteProgress
items.description: The thin bar across the top of the screen while the app loads the next page or submits a form, so a click that waits on the server never feels frozen: one global affordance instead of a pending state on every action.

items.name: color-scheme-toggle
items.title: ColorSchemeToggle
items.description: The dark mode control: it switches the app between light, dark and the system's scheme, and keeps the choice.

items.name: page-header
items.title: PageHeader
items.description: The top of a page: its title with an optional line above it (`eyebrow`), a description under it, the page's actions beside it, and a trail and an image above.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: CopyButton
items.description: A button that puts a piece of text on the clipboard: an API key, a link, a command.

items.name: code-block
items.title: CodeBlock
items.description: Code or a command on a muted surface in the theme's monospace font, with a caption and a button that copies it.

items.name: timer
items.title: Timer
items.description: A countdown timer with its own controls: the time left in large numbers, Start, then Pause and Cancel, Resume when paused, and at zero "Time's up" with Dismiss and Restart.

items.name: timer-tray
items.title: TimerTray
items.description: The timers that are running, paused or finished, in one strip, so a person who leaves a timer's screen can still see it count down, hear it at zero, and stop it.

items.name: celebrate
items.title: Celebrate
items.description: A small moment of celebration for something the person finished: confetti bursts from a badge with the message ("List cleared") and screen readers hear the message once.

items.name: choice-card
items.title: ChoiceCard
items.description: A set of choices shown as cards, each with a picture, a label and a line of description, for picking exactly one: a cover photo, a plan, a layout.

items.name: image-cropper
items.title: ImageCropper
items.description: A dialog for cropping a photo to a shape before it is used: drag the photo (or move it the way the arrow keys point) to choose what shows in the frame, zoom with the slider (or Plus and Minus), and Save hands the cropped image to `onCrop` as a `File`, ready for a form or an upload.

items.name: image-field
items.title: ImageField
items.description: A field for one photo, shown large: the photo already saved (`src`) or the one just chosen, with Choose photo (Change photo once one shows) and Remove.

items.name: share-button
items.title: ShareButton
items.description: A button that shares a link: through the system's share sheet where there is one (phones, Safari), and by copying it where there is not, when it says "Link copied" for two seconds and screen readers hear it once.

items.name: sync-status
items.title: SyncStatus
items.description: One line that says where the person's changes are: Saved, Saving…, Offline (kept on this device) or Not saved (the server refused the changes), each with its icon, and Retry while there is a problem.

items.name: local-date
items.title: LocalDate
items.description: A date (and time) in the reader's own time zone and language, in a `<time>` that carries the exact instant.

items.name: relative-time
items.title: RelativeTime
items.description: How long ago (or how soon) something happens, in the reader's language: "3 days ago", "yesterday", "in 5 minutes", "now", kept current while it shows.

items.name: install-prompt
items.title: InstallPrompt
items.description: A quiet offer to install the web app, shown only where the browser can install it (Chromium on Android and desktops), never while it already runs installed, and not again for two weeks after Not now.

items.name: conversation-list
items.title: ConversationList
items.description: A list of conversations to choose from: each row shows the avatar, the title, when the latest message arrived and a line of it, and marks unread conversations with a bold title and a dot.

items.name: attention-card
items.title: AttentionCard
items.description: Something that waits on the person: a mention, a question asked of them or a request still unanswered.

items.name: reaction-bar
items.title: ReactionBar
items.description: A message's reactions: each one's emoji and how many chose it, with the person's own pressed and tinted, and quick reactions to add with a single press.

items.name: lightbox
items.title: Lightbox
items.description: Thumbnails that open a full-screen image viewer.

items.name: composer
items.title: Composer
items.description: A chat message box: text that grows from one line as the person writes, a send button, and room for the rest of a composer, in one frame with one focus outline.

items.name: emoji-picker
items.title: EmojiPicker
items.description: An emoji picker for reactions and for putting emoji into text.

items.name: navigation-rail
items.title: NavigationRail
items.description: The vertical bar of the app's top-level pages on the start edge of a wide screen, as in a chat or mail app or an editor's activity bar: each item an icon over a short label, the current one with its `currentIcon`, a bar on the rail's edge and `aria-current="page"`.

items.name: time-grid
items.title: TimeGrid
items.description: A day, work week or week of hours, with events placed by their times: the calendar grid of a mail or meeting app.

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: A row of controls for one surface, such as an editor's formatting: Button commands and Toggle states, in groups with separators.

items.name: agent-presence
items.title: AgentPresence
items.description: The person's always-visible sign of which of their agents are listening to something on their behalf, such as a meeting, with Stop one click away.

items.name: autocomplete
items.title: Autocomplete
items.description: Suggestions at the text caret: typing a trigger character, such as `@` for people or `:` for emoji, in a `TextArea` or `TextField` opens a list beside the caret, filtered by what follows the character.

items.name: emoji
items.title: Emoji
items.description: One emoji from an image catalogue, drawn as an `` the size of the text around it, named by its `alt` (the emoji's name).

items.name: level-meter
items.title: LevelMeter
items.description: A small live input level: a row of bars that light from the start edge as a microphone picks up sound, so the person can tell it hears them before anyone else does (before joining a call, in a device menu, in a "test your microphone" row).

items.name: live-captions
items.title: LiveCaptions
items.description: A caption band for a live call or video: what people are saying, as they say it.

items.name: media-tile
items.title: MediaTile
items.description: A tile for one live picture in a call: a person's camera, their photo when the camera is off, or a shared screen.

items.name: moment
items.title: Moment
items.description: A moment in an app's life, shown in the space it is given: nothing here yet, on its way, something failed, a first run, or something finished.

items.name: snap-pip
items.title: SnapPiP
items.description: A floating picture inside a container, such as the person's own camera in a call, that they drag and throw into a corner, where it comes to rest, as a phone's picture in picture does.

items.name: family-bar
items.title: FamilyBar
items.description: The slim strip above a site's own header that links every site of a family, the same links in the same order on each, after a small heading that says what it is ("Ouro family").

items.name: family-footer
items.title: FamilyFooter
items.description: The foot of a family's site: the `FamilyBar`'s links, in the same order, in a quiet row that wraps, with the site being shown marked the same way, and the site's own extras (`children`) after them.

items.name: hero
items.title: Hero
items.description: The top of a page: a headline with an optional line above it (`eyebrow`) and a status beside that (`badge`), a trail above them (`breadcrumb`), a lede under the headline (`description`), the page's buttons (`actions`), more such as a byline (`children`), and a big picture, or something live in its place (`media`), below.

items.name: porthole
items.title: Porthole
items.description: The status spot: a small round window with one line about how current the app's data is, which opens into the facts behind it.

items.name: a2ui-surface
items.title: A2UISurface
items.description: Shows the UI an agent composed in A2UI, with Ouro HX: it resolves the messages into core's composed tree, draws it as ComposedSurface does, its fields starting from the surface's data model, and sends a press as A2UI's action message, with what the person entered in a field a button's input is bound to.

items.name: thread-rail
items.title: ThreadRail
items.description: A thread beside its conversation: a labelled landmark with a header and a close button.

items.name: ouro-mcp-app
items.title: OuroMcpApp
items.description: The view an MCP server returns for agent-composed UI (MCP Apps): the host, such as Claude or ChatGPT, frames it, and it shows the latest tool result's card: Ouro's composed tree in `structuredContent.ouro` with ComposedSurface, once it passes core's `validateTree` against the catalog, its fields starting from `structuredContent.ouro.data`, or A2UI messages in `structuredContent.a2ui` with `A2UISurface`.

items.name: composed-surface
items.title: ComposedSurface
items.description: Draws Ouro's composed tree with Ouro HX, whatever format it came in: core's `ComposedNode`, from A2UI messages, an MCP tool result's `structuredContent.ouro`, or your own code.

items.name: unread-dot
items.title: UnreadDot
items.description: The dot that marks something unread: a small round dot in the theme's primary color, with a spoken label.

items.name: agent-handoff
items.title: AgentHandoff
items.description: What a person does once they have seen something built for agents: hand it to their coding agent, as one line to paste, with Copy beside it.

items.name: app-window
items.title: AppWindow
items.description: A live piece of interface framed as an application's window: a title bar with a label (such as the file the demo lives in) and actions at its end, the working content inside, and the Ouro HX components it is built from along its foot.

items.name: cover
items.title: Cover
items.description: A thing's cover: its picture, or, without one, the first letter of its title in the theme's heading font on a solid tint of the muted color toward the primary.

items.name: section-header
items.title: SectionHeader
items.description: The head of a section inside a page: its title in the theme's heading font, a short count in small capitals at the end of the row (`meta`), an optional text action such as a link to the whole list, and a hairline under it.

items.name: thread-layout
items.title: ThreadLayout
items.description: A conversation beside its thread.

items.name: chat-header
items.title: ChatHeader
items.description: The bar above an open chat: who it is with, and what you can do there.

items.name: typing-indicator
items.title: TypingIndicator
items.description: The line under a chat that says who is writing: their faces, pulsing dots and "Ned Land is writing…".

items.name: read-receipt
items.title: ReadReceipt
items.description: Who has seen a message, as small faces under it: the first three readers, overlapping, then "+N" for the rest.

items.name: theme-picker
items.title: ThemePicker
items.description: The look chooser: each look's name in its own heading face and ink, on its own paper, ending in one flat square of its primary, so the name is the specimen.

items.name: page-shell
items.title: PageShell
items.description: The page column of a site: centred content with a side gutter that grows with the screen, and a wider column on big screens.

items.name: conversation-find
items.title: ConversationFind
items.description: The find bar for a conversation: a box with previous and next buttons, the match's place ("2 of 5") and a close button.

items.name: freshness
items.title: Freshness
items.description: How old the data on screen is, and whether the app's cache is fetching it again: "Updated 3 minutes ago", with a small icon that turns while it refreshes.

items.name: preview-bar
items.title: PreviewBar
items.description: A bar for trying a change before keeping it: the app shows a proposal live (a theme, a layout, an edit), and the bar says what it is and offers Keep, Throw away and Compare with the original.

items.name: build-chip
items.title: BuildChip
items.description: A compact, neutral chip for the title bar, like Xcode's scheme and activity area: it names the build the window runs ("Official 1.2.3", or "branch · sha" with "+ edits" for local changes not yet in any build), and opens a picker of the official build plus the builds serving now so a person can switch to the official build from the trigger.

items.name: ouro-tests
items.title: Ouro tests
items.description: Optional: every Ouro UI component with its tests, type tests, stories and Playwright spec, and the test kit. The whole suite in one command. It names Vitest, Playwright and Storybook without a version, so the CLI installs one only when your app lacks it and never changes a version you have.

items.name: ouro-census
items.title: Ouro census
items.description: Optional: the census journey kit. A Playwright spec of yours lists the pages your app renders and the states a person can open on them; the census records the exact multiset of visible controls in each (role, name, Ouro marker, context) and fails on any change from the committed baseline, and on any unmarked control in a journey you enrol. Unmarked controls may only fall, state by state. It installs e2e/ouro-census/ (the spec helper, the merge, the baseline update and a comparison of two runs).

items.name: ouro-source-rules
items.title: Ouro source rules
items.description: Optional: the hand-rolled-control source rule. It reads your app's source with the TypeScript compiler and its stylesheets with PostCSS, and finds the controls still built by hand (a raw <button>, <a>, <input>, a click handler on a <div>, another UI library's control, control-state styling) and every component that wraps one, as fingerprints held to a committed baseline that may only shrink. It installs scripts/ouro-source-rules.mjs.

items.name: ouro-check
items.title: Ouro check
items.description: Optional: the screen check. It opens every page of a built folder or a URL in headless Chromium at every screen size from 320 to 3840 wide, light and dark, and finds overlap, sideways scroll, clipped text, blurry pictures, pictures that fade into the page and serious axe-core violations, and long lines only where ouro-check.json declares a measure, and narrow text where a max-width holds prose well short of its column, each with a captioned close-up and a contact sheet per page. It measures layout shift while loading, the time to the first content and each press's time to paint, each against a budget, and records each number in its report. A run split with --shard k/n and joined with merge finds what one run does. Its fades.ts finds every gradient used as a mask in your source, and every wash laid over a picture, so no picture fades into the page. It installs scripts/ouro/check/.

items.name: ouro-images
items.title: Ouro images
items.description: Optional: the picture sizes. It writes each raster picture in a folder as AVIF and WebP at each width up to its own, with sharp, and images.json with the srcset of each, for a <picture> element. It installs scripts/ouro/images/.

items.name: ouro-feel-probe
items.title: Ouro Feel probe
items.description: Optional: Ouro Feel's probe, one plain script, built from feel/probe/probe.ts, that a page runs first to measure how its list feels: jumps, blank frames, late frames, input to motion and layout reads. It installs scripts/ouro/feel/ouro-feel-probe.js.

items.name: dashboard-page
items.title: Dashboard page
items.description: A page pattern: a whole dashboard page: a header with the light and dark toggle, the numbers that matter in cards, a chart of the last months and a table of recent activity.

items.name: list-detail-page
items.title: List detail page
items.description: A page pattern: a whole list-and-detail page: a header with the light and dark toggle, a list you can search, and the detail of the entry chosen beside it.

items.name: settings-page
items.title: Settings page
items.description: A page pattern: a whole settings page: a header with the light and dark toggle, a profile form the browser validates, and a danger zone that confirms before it deletes.

items.name: ax-bundle
items.title: ax-bundle
items.description: Ouro AX: A diagnostics bundle: one JSON file a doctor writes for an agent to read or attach, the agent's version of a desktop app's "get logs" menu item.

items.name: ax-checks
items.title: ax-checks
items.description: Ouro AX: A tool's checks, such as a doctor or a self-check, declared once: progress while they run, the verdict first and the results grouped for a person, the same facts as `--json` for an agent, the time taken and the exit code.

items.name: ax-claims
items.title: ax-claims
items.description: Ouro AX: the Ouro AX standard as data: a claim is one checkable rule about an interface an agent uses, with the reason, the evidence that admitted it, the check `ax-xray` runs and the fix.

items.name: ax-cli
items.title: ax-cli
items.description: Ouro AX: the whole front door for a tool built on the kit: parse, help, run (or, on `--dry-run`, plan), print the result as text or `--json`, and turn every failure into the one error line and its exit code.

items.name: ax-command
items.title: ax-command
items.description: Ouro AX: one definition of a command: its words, effect, arguments and flags, examples and output.

items.name: ax-component
items.title: ax-component
items.description: Ouro AX: A component's agent side: what an agent may read from it and which of its actions an agent may take, each bound to the CLI command that does the same (its twin).

items.name: ax-dev-commands
items.title: ax-dev-commands
items.description: Ouro AX: A message for an agent or a person names only what the installed tool runs: never a developer command, a repository path or a step that only works in a source checkout.

items.name: ax-doctor
items.title: ax-doctor
items.description: Ouro AX: A doctor: a tool's checks (ax-checks) with the state they judged, so a person and an agent read the same facts.

items.name: ax-effects
items.title: ax-effects
items.description: Ouro AX: effect classes: a command either touches only the person's own space ("private") or reaches other people ("others").

items.name: ax-example
items.title: ax-example
items.description: Ouro AX: a small tool built only from the kit, the pattern to copy; the ax tests use it.

items.name: ax-exit-codes
items.title: ax-exit-codes
items.description: Ouro AX: A tool's exit codes as one table: the overview, every command's footer, `help --json` and the MCP error shape read it, so the numbers never drift.

items.name: ax-flows
items.title: ax-flows
items.description: Ouro AX: an adopter's agent flows as data, run in CI without a model: a flow is the calls a good agent makes for one task, and the runner checks the calls' exit codes, JSON shapes and fields, error text, time, size and voice.

items.name: ax-lint
items.title: ax-lint
items.description: Ouro AX: the kit's check of a tool's declarations: what an agent needs from every declared command (a summary, an example, described arguments and flags, `--why` and a preview where other people see it, help that fits the width), and, against the tool's own command inventory, that every command it registers runs through its declaration.

items.name: ax-mcp
items.title: ax-mcp
items.description: Ouro AX: the same definitions as an MCP server over stdio (newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0), with no dependencies: one tool per command, its inputSchema from the definition, calls checked before they run with the fix in the one error shape, effects as tool annotations, and results cut to a size an agent's context can hold.

items.name: ax-outcome
items.title: ax-outcome
items.description: Ouro AX: the outcome of an action: what became of it, who can see it, whether that was checked, how to find it again and what to run next, in one shape over a CLI's `--json`, an HTTP route and an MCP tool.

items.name: ax-output
items.title: ax-output
items.description: Ouro AX: one result, two renderings: `--json` prints the data, text prints what the command's text() makes of the same data.

items.name: ax-precise-copy
items.title: ax-precise-copy
items.description: Ouro AX: A failure says what happened and precisely why (the system and its answer: "The mail service says this file was deleted"), who or what caused it where that is known, and the next step as a working action.

items.name: ax-probe
items.title: ax-probe
items.description: Ouro AX: how a doctor tells a local process's state from outside it, so it answers whatever state the app is in: an HTTP endpoint that answers is up, one that takes the request and gives no answer in time is stuck, and one that refuses it is down.

items.name: ax-problem
items.title: ax-problem
items.description: Ouro AX: one error shape for every agent surface: the CLI's stderr line, its `--json` error and an MCP tool error all carry the same fields, so an agent learns one repair loop.

items.name: ax-redact
items.title: ax-redact
items.description: Ouro AX: redaction for a diagnostics bundle: what leaves the computer for an agent to read or attach keeps categories, counts, times, versions and the tool's own words, and drops tokens, cookies, ids, email addresses, paths in a person's home and what anyone wrote.

items.name: ax-surfaces
items.title: ax-surfaces
items.description: Ouro AX: what a repository hands the checker: its agent-facing words as one JSON file a repository can produce cheaply.

items.name: ax-terminal
items.title: ax-terminal
items.description: Ouro AX: what a terminal shows a person, with a plain fallback off a terminal: colour, status marks, the time something took, next steps and a progress line for anything slow.

items.name: ax-voice
items.title: ax-voice
items.description: Ouro AX: A tool's voice: an optional line of character after the facts, for a person at a terminal, never where an agent parses.

items.name: ax-wait
items.title: ax-wait
items.description: Ouro AX: A typed wait: the agent names a reference it already holds, the tool waits (polling, if it must, where the agent cannot see it) until something happens or the time limit passes, and returns what happened with the cursor that resumes the wait.

items.name: ax-work-event
items.title: ax-work-event
items.description: Ouro AX: an attributed work event: who acted and for whom, on what, why, with which receipt, when.

items.name: ax-xray
items.title: ax-xray
items.description: Ouro AX: the Ouro AX conformance checker: it calls a CLI, an HTTP API, an MCP server or a harness's in-turn tools the way an agent would, and reports which claims hold on which surface, with the fix where a claim does not hold.
